label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 170 ]

blocks.text: People around the world eat in different ways, and each way has its own history. In many Western countries, people usually eat with knives and forks, while in China chopsticks are the common choice. In parts of Saudi Arabia, some traditional dishes are eaten with the right hand. People who follow this custom sometimes ask, “Why should we eat with utensils that other people have used? Our own hands may be cleaner.” They also point out that they know whether their hands are clean and that nobody else uses them.
